captures.textAlternative: Fig. 1 is now a 3D block of the valley standing on the page, in sandstone, after 300 model years. A glacier fills the valley from the head down to its snout, 88 percent of the way along. The front face of the block, 4.3 km down the valley, is cut through the glacier. In sandstone, after 300 model years, its cross-section is closer to a U than a V (shape 1.6; a V is about 1, a U about 2). The floor is 180 m wide and 260 m deep, lowered 40 m below the dashed starting V; the steepest wall is 42 degrees.
